what: Did the 2026-07-28 mechanics batch make MAG play better? New MAG (48 features) against the pre-batch build (47 features, commit 2a60c1d) on the SAME battles, sides swapped.
verdict: INCONCLUSIVE, point estimate below 50%. The batch did not improve playing strength and may have slightly hurt it.
corroborating: opponent joint recall at k=5 +0.5 points
caveat: Both builds carry their own board.js and weights, which is the only clean way to compare across a feature-list change. Teams are sampled from the clean ladder store by seed, identical for both sides.
